hook: *112* new DSPs could be sent abroad to study policing
hook_b: *112* new DSPs could be sent abroad to study policing
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy addressed the passing-out of the second DSP batch (2025) at MCR HRD Institute.

beats.what: He said the govt is willing to send new DSPs abroad and flagged cybercrime as a major threat.
beats.why: The CM said crime patterns have changed, with people losing money to fraudsters they never meet.
beats.care: These officers will lead police subdivisions, including cyber, drugs and traffic work.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI: The CM cited the Eagle Force for drug control and new systems for food safety and cybercrime.

qs: What would officers learn abroad that cannot be taught here?

facts.t: CM said Telangana's next *30 years* partly rest with this batch.

learn.t: DSP = Deputy Superintendent of Police, who usually heads a police subdivision.

watch: Whether a foreign training programme for DSPs is formally announced.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: CM Revanth urges new Telangana DSPs to tackle emerging crimes

fact: Telangana's *112 new DSPs* may be sent abroad to study global policing.
twist: Govt school teachers are already being sent overseas to study education practices, the CM said.
